ldapsearch -x -H ldap://ldap.itnsa.id \
  -b "ou=mail,dc=itnsa,dc=id" \
  "(uid=budi)" dn homeDirectory



# Search all users in ou=mail
ldapsearch -x -H ldap://int-srv.lks2026.diy \
  -b "ou=mail,dc=lks2026,dc=diy" \
  "(objectClass=posixAccount)" uid

# Search specific user
ldapsearch -x -H ldap://int-srv.lks2026.diy \
  -b "ou=mail,dc=lks2026,dc=diy" \
  "(uid=mail1)" dn homeDirectory

# Test LDAP bind (verify password)
ldapwhoami -x -H ldap://int-srv.lks2026.diy \
  -D "uid=mail1,ou=mail,dc=lks2026,dc=diy" \
  -w "Skills39"
